note: Two readings per surge tier. (1) TOUCH hit-rate: a Close reached +pct in the window (optimistic — assumes you sold the top); Wilson 90% CI. EV is GROSS of costs/slippage; equity_curve treats entries as one-at-a-time sequential trades (ignores overlap) — a sanity curve, not a backtest.
